scope: Independent offline receiver-by-receiver summation and analytic-quadrature review of the complete fixed initial soil graph. Only this new review and matching note were written. No GenCase, solver, integration, production/formal edit, retained-evidence edit or Git operation was performed.

provenance.scope: Every explicit input entry plus the bound metrics CSV in the source receipt was SHA/size checked before and after the calculation; duplicate paths were counted once. The source receipt itself is separately SHA bound above.

source_mapping.cpu_moment: src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:735-760 constructs M=-sum Vop*d outer g and stores its inverse CorrMat.
source_mapping.cpu_porecorr: src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:2318 takes the receiving particle CorrMat; lines2462-2472 contract d with C_i*g.
source_mapping.cpu_darcy: src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:2468 and2482-2484 use float-divided neighbour volume, pressure difference and positive coefficient 2*(Kw/n)*k/(rho_w*g).
source_mapping.gpu_darcy: src/source/JSphGpu_ker.cu:1814-1835 has the corresponding receiver-C Darcy contraction and pressure difference.
source_mapping.kernel: src/source/FunSphKernel.h:198-199 and217-221 define 3D Wendland bwen and its radial gradient factor.
source_mapping.not_the_stress_rate_toggle: This porecorr is the free-surface/tracking CorrMat inverse, not an operator enabled or disabled by SoilStressRateGradCorr.

independent_method.neighbours: cKDTree query_ball_point receiver lists, excluding self, cutoff2h. No imported original batches/correction/rate helper was used.
independent_method.gradient: g_ij=(bwen/h)*(1-r_ij/(2h))^3*d_ij with source float bwen promoted to double; geometry and distance arithmetic remain double.
independent_method.moment_and_inverse: Each receiver M_i=-sum_j Vop_j*d_ij outer g_ij was directly summed, then independently inverted with numpy.linalg.inv.
independent_method.rate: Each receiver, each of three manufactured fields and each of three operator choices was directly summed over its own directed neighbour list; CPU/GPU labels change only the source scalar constants.
independent_method.maximum_difference_metric: rate_max_pa_s, raw_I_offline quartic_Neumann; approximately31-40millionPa/s rates make this a floating summation-order difference.
independent_method.comparison_tolerance: 1e-6+2e-12*abs(stored_value), only for independent arithmetic reconciliation, not a physical gate.

pair_algebra.definitions: d_ij=x_i-x_j; g_ij=grad_i W_ij; H_i,ij=d_ij^T C_i g_ij/(r_ij^2+Eta2); D=2*(Kw/n)*k/(rho_w*g)>0.
pair_algebra.reverse_end: d_ji=-d_ij and g_ji=-g_ij, so H_j,ji=d_ij^T C_j g_ij/(r^2+Eta2); only the pressure difference changes sign.
pair_algebra.common_pair_H: Raw I or a shared symmetric-C contraction gives H_i=H_j on the pair; the integral cancels with consistent volumes. The present uniform float/native volume ratio preserves this cancellation.
pair_algebra.sign_check: The radial kernel factor is negative and both independently formed moment matrices are positive definite; therefore the directional H is negative. A higher-pressure receiver gets a negative diffusion contribution and its reverse receiver gets a positive contribution. Their magnitudes need not balance for receiver-C.

continuum_reference.continuum_rate_coefficient: kappa=(Kw/n)*k/(rho_w*g)=D/2; exact pressure rate is kappa*Laplacian(p), not D*Laplacian(p).
continuum_reference.discrete_moment_identity: sum V*Laplacian(p)=20*P/R^2*(sum V)*(weighted_mean(r^2/R^2)-3/5). A uniform mass/volume rescaling cannot alter the weighted mean or make its nonzero mean rate vanish.

native_geometry_results_cpu_scalar.energy_caveat: Negative quadratic change in this field coexists with positive integrated pressure rate; dissipation, constant null, shift invariance and weighted conservation are separate properties.

virtual_cartesian_results_cpu_scalar.construction: In memory only: dp*(i,j,k), integer indices in[-20,20] and i^2+j^2+k^2<=400, same R/dp/h and per-node native/operator volume as above. No GenCase, FSType setup or solver was run.
virtual_cartesian_results_cpu_scalar.interpretation: The receiver-C pair defect persists with almost-correct global volume and a much smaller, opposite-signed analytic quadrature mean. It is not explained solely by FrDraw's total-volume surplus. This different truncated graph is not an accepted replacement layout or continuum-boundary treatment.

limitations: Nonzero integrated rate is not, by itself, proof of real external leakage. The manufactured continuous Neumann condition is not automatically implemented by a truncated neighbour graph.

The current FrDraw analytic pointwise Laplacian already has a large nonzero native-volume quadrature integral. Do not label all receiver-C integrated drift as physical fluid loss/gain or subtract differently normalized drift percentages as a causal decomposition.

The pair identity independently establishes failure of native-volume pair cancellation in this frozen uniform state; it does not establish the magnitude or cause of the coupled, deforming, drained Cryer trajectory error.
The all-soil diagnostic includes surface receivers that actual drained production evolution may omit or overwrite. It is not a replay of the Cryer drainage boundary.

Raw I and symmetric-C are offline contrasts only. Their exact weighted net cancellation does not prove local second-order consistency, correct boundary response, coupled energy, stability, CPU/GPU replay or physical accuracy.

The current receiver-C has the smallest local quartic rate RMS difference on the native FrDraw layout, while raw I has the smallest on the virtual Cartesian layout. No operator is selected or recommended for production from this diagnostic.

CPU/GPU results here use distinct source scalar constants but shared double geometry, kernel-distance and manufactured pressure arithmetic. They are not real-program backend validation or 0-ULP checks.
No mass normalization, particle replacement, physical equation, drainage rule, precision state, production/formal input or threshold was changed. No new simulation or Git backup was performed.
